project.title: CYANOTECH-WP4
project.description: The data was form THE RESEARCH AND INNOVATION FOUNDATIONPROGRAMMES "A sustainable and innovative management system for toxic cyanobacteria blooming of surface waters with combined energy production, sustainable agriculture, and food safety". Two pure cultured cyanobacteria species were used as feedstock for anaerobic species. The microbial community were measured in reactors.
